aliases: Immortal battlefield killer move quasi blessed land

summary.text: An immortal battlefield is an immortal level battlefield killer move: a temporary domain that replicates dao marks and remakes the fight space. The text also calls these moves quasi blessed lands.

claims.text: Rolling Rock Battlefield is named an immortal battlefield killer move. Forming such a move needs at least three Immortal Gu connected in some way. The grey rock domain expands over fighter and foe, looks from outside like a huge grey rock cloud that blocks vision, and isolates the inside and outside of the domain.

Immortal battlefield killer moves have another name: quasi blessed lands. Once used, they temporarily replicate countless dao marks and create a temporary unique battlefield. Most Gu Immortals do not possess them; only relatively few do.

Battlefield killer moves normally take a long time to set up. Fang Yuan’s star soul battlefield needs at least a few minutes, treated as average beside other battlefield killer moves. Fairy Li Shan’s immortal battlefield killer move orchard garden in mountain was prepared in advance before the fight in his previous life memory.

Talk of battlefield killer moves clashing with an immortal aperture’s dao marks refers to immortal battlefield killer moves. Fang Yuan’s dark veil is mortal level and is not problematic inside the aperture on that rule.
Immortal battlefield killer moves can create an environment that benefits the user. Peach blossom maze changes desert terrain and forces a hidden palace into exposure once the field is set.
Battlefield killer moves as the wider class are covered on Battlefield Killer Move. Killer moves in general are covered on killer moves.
